sections.heading: Wearing
sections.text:
• Avoid rough surfaces, jewellery and bag straps that can catch the weave.
• Let a piece rest for a day between wears so the fibres can recover.
• Remove perfume and hairspray before putting it on, not after.
sections.haystack: wearing pashmina care guide avoid rough surfaces jewellery and bag straps that can catch the weave let a piece rest for a day between wears so the fibres can recover remove perfume and hairspray before putting it on not after

sections.heading: Washing
sections.text:
• Dry cleaning is the safest choice.
• To hand wash, use cool water and a gentle wool or cashmere detergent. Soak briefly and swirl gently — never rub.
• Rinse in cool water. Don’t wring. Roll the piece in a clean towel to press the water out.
• Dry flat, away from direct sunlight and heat.
sections.haystack: wash pashmina care guide dry wash is the safest choice to hand wash use cool water and a gentle wool or pashmina detergent soak briefly and swirl gently never rub rinse in cool water don't wring roll the piece in a wash towel to press the water out dry flat away from direct sunlight and heat

sections.heading: Pressing
sections.text: Use a cool iron through a clean cotton cloth, or steam lightly from a distance.
sections.haystack: pressing pashmina care guide use a cool iron through a wash cotton cloth or steam lightly from a distance

sections.heading: Storing
sections.text:
• Fold rather than hang, so the piece doesn’t stretch.
• Store clean, in a breathable cotton bag, somewhere cool and dry.
• Cedar blocks or lavender help keep moths away.
